trust_decision.summary: Whether a tooltip's content may be rendered as HTML is decided client-side, per selector, in the tippy initializer that ships to the browser (allowHTML on '[data-tippy-content]'), not where the content is produced; Blade's attribute escaping in the components that emit request headers, the full request URL, routing values, SQL and frame source does not protect the later innerHTML assignment.

landing_point.why: The summary names the exception-page tooltip, and this is the single call that enables HTML for every element carrying a data-tippy-content attribute.

fix_sites.entry_point: the script actually served into the debug page by Renderer::js(), which file_get_contents() the dist bundle

O3_reason_to_dismiss: dist/scripts.js is generated output: the source of truth is scripts.js and 'npm run build' (vite) regenerates it, so hand-editing the bundle is the maintainer's/build step's job, not part of the tooltip fix.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what:
The Queries tooltip deliberately embeds nl2br($sql) so multi-line SQL keeps its line breaks; the invariant is written down as testQueryTooltipRendersMultilineSafely. A blanket allowHTML:false on '[data-tippy-content]' makes those tooltips show a literal '
' instead of a break, so a solver is tempted to keep HTML enabled (or to keep the SQL tooltip on the HTML path) and leave the sink open.

O6_input_shapes: plain-text tooltip content via data-tippy-content, rendered with allowHTML:false
HTML-bearing tooltip content moved to a new data-tippy-html-content attribute, rendered with allowHTML:true
multi-line values (frame source with newlines, nl2br-wrapped SQL)
values containing angle brackets / script markup, as in request headers and the full request URL

O8_uncovered_routes.route: The full request URL is interpolated as a raw JS string literal inside the Alpine x-data attribute of the request-URL component; a quote in the URL breaks out of the string into the copy-handler body at page load / click, i.e. script execution in the debug page from request data.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: It is a different sink from tippy (Alpine expression evaluation), it only runs inside the copy handler after the developer clicks Copy, and the URL is already displayed escaped next to it, so it can be argued to be a separate hardening task.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same directory, one file away from scripts.js; not reached through the tooltip initializer at all

O8b_injection_room.sibling: another code/SQL viewer that pushes shiki output into the page through Alpine x-html
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: frame-code, vendor-frame and request-body already share this component, so a maintainer adding a highlighted-code tooltip or preview would reuse the same HTML pipeline and a new attribute selector.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: the copy-as-markdown transport printing the same headers/query values with raw {!! !!}
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: it is the second presentation of exactly the request information the tooltips show, so a maintainer fixing tooltip escaping could plausibly touch, or forget, this sibling transport.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: request-body JSON rendered through the shared syntax-highlight component without any tooltip attribute
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: the raw request body is the most attacker-controlled string on the page; wrapping it in a data-tippy-content preview is a natural feature addition next to the headers and URL tooltips.

O9_family: xss (improper neutralization of HTML/script in debug-page tooltip content, CWE-80)

O10_build.language: JavaScript (renderer bundle) plus PHP (framework that serves it)
O10_build.toolchain: PHP 8.x + Composer + PHPUnit/Orchestra Testbench; Node >=22.19 + npm + Vite 7 for the renderer workspace (npm run build emits dist/scripts.js; npm install needs network at build time)

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Set allowHTML:false on the single tippy('[data-tippy-content]') call in scripts.js, or escape the header/URL values again in the Blade components, and stop there, leaving the served dist bundle and the Alpine-attributed URL path untouched.

out_of_scope_notes: The same fix commit also edits tests/Integration/Concurrency/ConcurrencyTest.php and tests/Integration/Queue/SerializableClosureV1QueueTest.php to set an APP_KEY via #[WithEnv]; unrelated to this advisory's protection and not pursued.
